evidence: Q1: ShareShotSchema and ShareSchema are strict, with 1 to 2 shots, the step regex ^[A-Z]\d{1,2}$, media photo or video, and a BiText caption; ScriptSchema.share is optional, so the change is additive; SHARE_CHECK_STATUS is 'fail' at HEAD (checks.ts:520); shareCheck runs before the published block (checks.ts:331 before :336), so a share problem fails the week and blocks a published week; the seven rules of FR-14 are implemented: a missing share, a step of the own script or a moved step of the day before, one shot in the period of the day, two different steps, no assessment step (E5 of a teach week, A1 of a review week), a caption of 1 to 40 words with a non-empty Thai caption, and no caption that ends in a media file extension.

Q2: with share off or absent the HTML equals the HTML without share fields byte for byte, with loops off and on (T1 guard, both languages, 8 weeks); the caption prints escaped (the MB8 and MB9 mutants are caught); the consent line and the length line print once in each week part, at the first shot of the first day that has a share (the MB12 to MB15 mutants are caught); make-manual-pdf.ts and make-teacher-book-print.ts pass share to compileStorytimeManual (the MB18, MB19, and MB20 mutants are caught); an unknown flag still exits 2 in both scripts.

Q3: the exit codes 0, 1, and 2 match FR-14; every problem line starts with the row id; the compare holds each cell as exact text after trim (the MX13 mutant is caught); the shots cell keeps the array order (the MX12 mutant is caught); a repeated row id reports '<id>: the row repeats' because lines 141 to 142 run before the no-share skip on line 146 and before the broken-week skip on line 153; a no-share id already carries '<id>: the week file has no share' on line 112, and a broken week carries 'wNN: the week file does not parse' on line 104, so both cases exit 1; the only silent skip is an empty week list, which the function documents as a default.

Q4: the draft path now builds the unit page list as make-teacher-book-print.ts builds it, from every week of the level, and passes it as studentBookPages to compileStorytimeManual (commit 40d51889); without the flag the helper output equals the old output byte for byte (B3 guard); the six mutants of the text-gate baseline, including the default-on form and the wrong-option-name form, each fail a test (mutants: 6, caught: 6).

Q5: every key test can fail; the mutant records in the captures match the plan text: MB mutants: 24, caught: 24, MX mutants: 13, caught: 13, tg mutants: 6, caught: 6, and the Green 1 record MS mutants: 12, caught: 12 with MC mutants: 23, caught: 20 and the survivors MC2 and MC3 that the plan names; no mutant-covered test passes for a wrong implementation; the two Green 1 survivors are the known gap of rule 2, which the plan records for a later Red task.

Q6: commit 14a8c5eb of the storytime_week_package track extends the allow-list of the share compare with books[].audio.wordClips and song.videoLeadInSeconds, the same keys that withoutNewFields of storytime-loops-content.test.ts removes, so the compare keeps the meaning of AC-14.5: a changed existing line still fails it, and the compare still removes scripts[].share from both sides; commit 69cd4db4 adds two optional fields to the schema and one check row; no other reader of StorytimeWeekSchema or StorytimeManualOptions breaks, because both new fields are optional and the option share has a default of false.

Q7: eight of the twelve [x] task lines of Phase 3b end with ' commit ' and 7 hex characters, and four do not (finding A-P3b-1); every capture that the Phase 3b plan names exists in measure/runs/storytime_teaching_loops_20261103, and its Test Files, Tests, mutants, and exit values match the plan text; the teacher book build task stays [ ] and its met parts at HEAD are the v2 build at commit ccf59077, PRINT_GATE exit 0 with All checks pass, 224 pages, 0 text-gate differences for each week, and the PM receipt of 2026-11-09; the open part is the contact sheet check by the orchestrator.
